mapper.select: SELECT categories, reader_interval, search_history FROM eh_preferences WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO eh_preferences (user_id, categories, reader_interval, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{categories,typeHandler=io.github.kzw200015.myapi.eh.StringListTypeHandler}, #{readerInterval}, now(), now()) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET categories = excluded.categories, reader_interval = excluded.reader_interval, updated_at = now()

INSERT INTO eh_preferences (user_id, search_history, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{entries,typeHandler=io.github.kzw200015.myapi.eh.StringListTypeHandler}, now(), now()) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET search_history = excluded.search_history, updated_at = now()
